market_question: Will Neymar play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
reasoning: Neymar will be 34 in 2026, coming off a major ACL injury in late 2023. While he aims to play, Brazil has a wealth of young attacking talent (Vinicius Jr, Rodrygo, Endrick) and his selection is far from guaranteed. The 81% implied probability is too high; I estimate around 70% true probability.
evidence_points: Neymar suffered an ACL tear in Oct 2023 requiring surgery and long rehab.
He will be 34 during the 2026 World Cup, an age when many Brazilian forwards decline.
Brazil has emerging stars who could limit his role or selection.
He has expressed a strong desire to play in 2026, and one brief appearance is enough for Yes.
sources_consulted: Reports on Neymar's ACL injury and recovery timeline
